gaps.sentence: There's no point ___ about it now.
gaps.explanation: there's no point + -ing: no point worrying.

gaps.sentence: She couldn't resist ___ the last biscuit.
I want you ___ the truth, whatever it is.
gaps.explanation: want + object + to-infinitive: want you to tell.
refuse takes the to-infinitive: refused to pay.

gaps.sentence: It's high time we ___ this attic.
gaps.explanation: it's (high) time + subject + past simple (unreal past): time we cleared.

gaps.sentence: The box was heavy enough ___ two people.
gaps.explanation: adjective + enough + to-infinitive: heavy enough to need.

gaps.sentence: I'd prefer ___ at home rather than go out.
gaps.explanation: would prefer + to-infinitive: I'd prefer to eat. (prefer + -ing for general likes.)

gaps.sentence: She decided ___ the job offer in Berlin.
gaps.explanation: decide takes the to-infinitive: decided to accept.
